population: orders due for delivery in Mumbai on 2025-08-14

corroborations.evidenceLabel: fleet congestion note or heavy-traffic record

feedbackSamples: Package cancelled due to stock issue.

caveats: Only ~63% of orders have fleet/warehouse/external/feedback records; factor rates use all orders in the population as denominator.
Association lifts describe co-occurrence, not causation; recorded failure_reason is the only tier-1 causal field.
Cross-table timestamps are unreliable in this dataset; all time filtering anchors on order dates.
Delivered-but-late orders carry no recorded failure_reason; their explanation rests on association evidence only.
